-- Module:Main page -- Draws the front page from the settings in Module:Main page/config.json. -- The Main Page itself only contains: {{#invoke:Main page|render}} -- To change what's on the front page, edit the settings, not this module.
local p = {}
local CONFIG_PAGE = 'Module:Main page/config.json' local STYLES = 'Template:Main page/styles.css' local PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE = 'Image unavailable.png' -- same as the infoboxes
-- =================================================================== -- Helpers -- ===================================================================
local lang = mw.language.getContentLanguage()
-- Settings come from mw.loadJsonData, whose lists don't support # (length): -- count them with ipairs instead. local function count(list) local n = 0 if list then for _ in ipairs(list) do n = n + 1 end end return n end
local function fileExists(name) if not name or name == '' then return false end local t = mw.title.new(name, 'File') return t ~= nil and t.file ~= nil and t.file.exists end
local function cleanFile(name) return name and mw.text.trim((name:gsub('^[Ff]ile:', ''):gsub('^[Ii]mage:', ''))) or nil end
-- Remove {{templates}}, even nested ones. local function stripTemplates(s) local out, depth, i = {}, 0, 1 while i <= #s do local two = s:sub(i, i + 1) if two == '{{' then depth = depth + 1; i = i + 2 elseif two == '}}' and depth > 0 then depth = depth - 1; i = i + 2 else if depth == 0 then table.insert(out, s:sub(i, i)) end i = i + 1 end end return table.concat(out) end
-- The first paragraph of an article as plain text, cut to about `max` characters. local function excerpt(content, max) local s = stripTemplates(content) s = s:gsub('<!%-%-.-%-%->', '') s = s:gsub('<ref[^>]-/>', ''):gsub('<ref.-</ref>', '') s = s:gsub('%[%[[Ff]ile:[^%]]-%]%]', ''):gsub('%[%[[Ii]mage:[^%]]-%]%]', ''):gsub('%[%[[Cc]ategory:[^%]]-%]%]', '') s = s:gsub('<[^>]->', '') for para in (s .. '\n\n'):gmatch('(.-)\n%s*\n') do local text = mw.text.trim(para) if text ~= '' and not text:match('^=') and not text:match('^[{|!]') and not text:match('^__') then text = text:gsub('%[%[[^%]|]-|([^%]]-)%]%]', '%1'):gsub('%[%[([^%]]-)%]%]', '%1') text = text:gsub('%[https?://%S+%s+([^%]]-)%]', '%1'):gsub("'''?", ''):gsub('%s+', ' ') text = mw.text.trim(text) if mw.ustring.len(text) > max then text = mw.ustring.sub(text, 1, max):gsub('%s+%S*$', '') .. '…' end return text end end return nil end
-- The picture from an article's infobox ("| image = …"). local function infoboxImage(content) local name = content:match('|%s*image%s*=%s*([^|\n}]+)') name = name and mw.text.trim(name) if name == '' then return nil end return name end
local function problem(text) return mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-problem'):wikitext('Main page settings: ' .. text) end
-- =================================================================== -- Parts of the page -- ===================================================================
local function hero(cfg) local box = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-hero')
if cfg.background and fileExists(cfg.background) then box:tag('div'):addClass('mp-hero-bg') :wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|1600px|link=|alt=]]', cleanFile(cfg.background))) end
local inner = box:tag('div'):addClass('mp-hero-inner')
if cfg.stats ~= false then local stats = inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-stats') for _, s in ipairs({ { mw.site.stats.articles, 'articles' }, { mw.site.stats.files, 'files' }, { mw.site.stats.users, 'members' }, { mw.site.stats.edits, 'edits' }, }) do local item = stats:tag('span'):addClass('mp-stat') item:tag('b'):wikitext(lang:formatNum(s[1])) item:wikitext(' ' .. s[2]) end end
local logo = cleanFile(cfg.logo) if logo and fileExists(logo) then inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-logo'):wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|180px|link=|alt=%s]]', logo, cfg.title or '')) end
if cfg.title then inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-title'):wikitext(cfg.title) end if cfg.subtitle then inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-subtitle'):wikitext(cfg.subtitle) end
-- Clicking this opens Citizen's own search popup. local search = cfg.search or {} if search.show ~= false then local bar = inner:tag('div') :addClass('mp-search'):addClass('citizen-search-trigger') :attr('role', 'button'):attr('tabindex', '0') bar:tag('span'):addClass('mp-search-icon') bar:tag('span'):addClass('mp-search-text'):wikitext(search.text or 'Search the wiki') if search.shortcutHint ~= false then bar:tag('span'):addClass('mp-search-hint'):wikitext('Press <kbd>/</kbd>') end -- Quick searches under the bar, e.g. "Characters" → search prefilled with that word. if count(search.suggestions) > 0 then local chips = inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-chips') for _, s in ipairs(search.suggestions) do chips:tag('span'):addClass('mp-chip'):addClass('citizen-search-trigger') :attr('role', 'button'):attr('tabindex', '0') :attr('data-citizen-search-prefill', s.prefill or s.label) :wikitext(s.label) end end end return box end
local function directories(cfg) if count(cfg.directories) == 0 then return nil end local row = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-directories') for _, d in ipairs(cfg.directories) do local link = d.link or (d.category and (':Category:' .. d.category)) or d.label if link:match('^[Cc]ategory:') then link = ':' .. link end local item = row:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir') if d.image and fileExists(d.image) then item:addClass('mp-dir--image') item:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-bg'):wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|400px|link=|alt=]]', cleanFile(d.image))) end local text = item:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-text') text:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-label'):wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', link, d.label)) if d.category and d.showCount ~= false then local n = mw.site.stats.pagesInCategory(d.category, 'pages') text:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-count'):wikitext(lang:formatNum(n) .. (n == 1 and ' page' or ' pages')) elseif d.description then text:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-count'):wikitext(d.description) end if d.icon and fileExists(d.icon) then item:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-icon'):wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|40px|link=|alt=]]', cleanFile(d.icon))) end end return row end
local function card(title, cls) local c = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-card') if cls then c:addClass(cls) end if title then c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-card-title'):wikitext(title) end return c end
-- Today's featured article: one page, or a list that changes every day. local function featured(cfg) local f = cfg.featured local n = f and count(f.pages) or 0 if n == 0 then return nil end local day = math.floor(os.time() / 86400) local pick = f.pages[(day % n) + 1] if type(pick) == 'string' then pick = { page = pick } end
local title = mw.title.new(pick.page or '') if not title or not title.exists then return problem(string.format('the featured page “%s” doesn’t exist.', tostring(pick.page))) end local content = title:getContent() or '' local image = cleanFile(pick.image) or cleanFile(infoboxImage(content)) if not fileExists(image) then image = fileExists(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE) and PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE or nil end local text = pick.text or excerpt(content, f.excerptLength or 220)
local c = card(nil, 'mp-featured') if image then c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-image') :wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|700px|link=%s|alt=%s]]', image, title.fullText, title.text)) end local body = c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-body') body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-kicker'):wikitext(f.label or 'Featured') body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-title'):wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', title.fullText, pick.label or title.text)) if text then body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-text'):wikitext(text) end body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-more'):wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', title.fullText, f.moreText or 'Read more')) return c end
local function recentChanges(frame, cfg) local rc = cfg.recentChanges if rc == false or (rc and rc.show == false) then return nil end rc = rc or {} local opts = { 'limit=' .. (rc.limit or 8), 'days=' .. (rc.days or 30) } if rc.hideBots ~= false then table.insert(opts, 'hidebots') end if rc.hideMinor then table.insert(opts, 'hideminor') end if rc.hideLogs ~= false then table.insert(opts, 'hidelog') end if rc.namespace ~= nil then table.insert(opts, 'namespace=' .. rc.namespace) end local c = card(rc.title or 'Recent changes', 'mp-rc') c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-rc-list'):wikitext(frame:preprocess('{{Special:RecentChanges/' .. table.concat(opts, ',') .. '}}')) c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-more'):wikitext('[[Special:RecentChanges|' .. (rc.moreText or 'All recent changes') .. ']]') return c end
local function intro(cfg) local i = cfg.intro if not i or not i.text or i.text == '' then return nil end local c = card(i.title, 'mp-intro') c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-intro-text'):wikitext('\n' .. i.text .. '\n') return c end
-- ===================================================================
function p.render(frame) local ok, cfg = pcall(mw.loadJsonData, CONFIG_PAGE) local out = { frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = STYLES }) } if not ok then table.insert(out, tostring(problem('couldn’t read [[' .. CONFIG_PAGE .. ']]. Check it exists and is valid JSON.'))) return table.concat(out) end
local page = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp') page:node(hero(cfg)) local dirs = directories(cfg) if dirs then page:node(dirs) end local i = intro(cfg) if i then page:node(i) end
local grid = page:tag('div'):addClass('mp-grid') local f = featured(cfg) if f then grid:node(f) end local rc = recentChanges(frame, cfg) if rc then grid:node(rc) end
table.insert(out, tostring(page)) return table.concat(out) end
return p

The front page. The '''Main Page''' only contains {{#invoke:Main page|render}}; everything on it is set in '''[[Module:Main page/config.json]]'''. Edit the settings there, not this module. == Settings == {| class="wikitable" ! Setting !! What it does |- | title, subtitle || The welcome line and the line under it. |- | logo || File name of the logo (shown round). Upload it first; until it exists, no logo shows. |- | background || Optional picture behind the top of the page. |- | stats || true shows the article, file, member and edit counts at the top. |- | search.text || The words in the search bar. Clicking it opens the site search. |- | search.suggestions || Small buttons under the search bar. Each opens search with its label (or prefill) typed in. |- | directories || The row of directory buttons. Each has a label and either a category (it links there and shows how many pages it has) or a link to any page. Optional: icon (a small picture on the right), image (a faint picture behind it), description (instead of the count), showCount: false. |- | intro || An optional welcome card: title and text (wikitext, links work). |- | featured.pages || Featured articles. With several, a different one shows each day. Each entry is a page name, or { "page": "…", "image": "…", "text": "…", "label": "…" } to override the picture, the text or the shown title. By default the picture comes from the article's infobox and the text is its first paragraph. |- | featured.label, excerptLength, moreText || The small label, how many characters of text to show, and the link text. |- | recentChanges || limit (how many), days, hideBots, hideMinor, hideLogs (uploads, moves, deletions), namespace (0 = articles only; leave it out for every kind of page), title, moreText. Set "show": false to remove it. |} Leave a setting out (or empty) to hide that part. Problems, like a featured page that doesn't exist, show as a red note on the front page. To try changes before they go live, preview any page with {{#invoke:Main page|render}} after saving the settings.
